name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump fumes over Canadian wildfire smoke and issues tariff threat
changes.summary: President Donald Trump on Friday pledged to hold Canada responsible for costs associated with unhealthy air quality in the U.S. due to spreading smoke from the Canadian wildfires.

changes.title: What to know about Trump's claim that over 250K non-citizens are registered to vote
changes.summary: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin sent letters to four states alleging that a combined 250,000 non-citizens were registered to vote. Elections experts caution that could be a significant overcount.

changes.title: As Trump Scraps With Meloni, His Envoy to Italy Is at Sea
changes.summary: Tilman J. Fertitta, the U.S. ambassador to Rome, is summering on his superyacht as President Trump squabbles with Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni of Italy.

changes.title: Trump threatens Canada with higher tariffs over wildfire smoke
changes.summary: President Trump threatened more tariffs on Canada for wildfires that have blanketed large parts of the Midwest and East Coast in smoke in recent days.

changes.title: What to know about the Trump administration's claim that 250K non-citizens are registered to vote in 4 states
changes.summary: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin sent letters to four states alleging that a combined 250,000 non-citizens were registered to vote. Elections experts caution that could be a significant overcount.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Both Marco Rubio and Elon Musk, who led the effort to sunset the foreign aid agency, have said that no deaths have been linked to the cutting of its funding. These parents tell a different story. (Image credit: From left: David Augustine, Lameck Nyagudi and Kazeem Olawale Nasiru for NPR).

changes.title: What a Times Reporter Saw in Iran, and Takeaways from Trump’s Speech on Election Security
Trump’s Obsession With Relitigating the 2020 Election Carries a Cost for Democracy
changes.summary: In demanding steps to address the integrity of voting, President Trump persisted in relitigating his 2020 election defeat while finding ways to cast doubt on the 2026 outcome.

changes.title: Trump encourages Darline Graham to run for Lindsey Graham's seat
changes.summary: Darline Graham indicated in a White House meeting Thursday that she's weighing a bid, CBS News confirmed. A day later, President Trump wrote on Truth Social: "RUN, DARLINE, RUN! ".

changes.title: China calls Trump's election interference claims "pure fabrication"
changes.summary: A spokesman for the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs denied President Trump's claims of election interference in the 2020 election. CBS News foreign correspondent Anna Coren reports.
